newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oita Paraxylene unit to come on stream on April 1.
newsitem.headline: Oita Paraxylene unit to come on stream on April 1.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd and Kyushu Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday that their Oita Paraxylene Co Ltd joint venture would start commercial operations at its 15 billion yen paraxylene unit from April 1.

Paraxylene produced at the 300,000-tonne-per-year facility, located at Kyushu Oil's Oita refinery in Kyushu, southern Japan, will be equally shared by Mitsubishi Oil and Kyushu Oil, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.
Both Mitsubishi Oil and Kyushu Oil intend to export their share of the paraxylene to Asian countries such as South Korea and Taiwan, spokesmen for the two companies said.
Paraxylene is used as feedstock to manufacture polyester fibre, audio tapes and soda bottles.
